title: Permissions

permission_descriptions.manage_realm: Change the guild settings and invite players.
permission_descriptions.delete_realm: Permanently delete the guild and its data.
permission_descriptions.view_roster: See the list of members and their characters.
permission_descriptions.edit_roster: Add or remove roster characters by hand.
permission_descriptions.sync_characters: Run the character sync with Battle.net.
permission_descriptions.manage_raid: Create and delete raids, open instances.
permission_descriptions.view_loot_history: See the items obtained in raids.
permission_descriptions.delete_loot: Remove entries from the loot history.
permission_descriptions.edit_loot: Change who received an assigned item.
permission_descriptions.import_simc: Import SimC profiles and simulation reports.
permission_descriptions.signup_event: Sign up for raids, from the app or Discord.
permission_descriptions.manage_event_roster: Add or remove players from a raid composition.
permission_descriptions.view_activity_log: See the history of actions taken in the guild.

description: Adjust the default permissions to control what users can do within the realm. Currently in read-only preview mode.
